svg.title: A strategy proposes its next parameters and cannot adopt them: one real run
svg.desc: RSI on 2026-10-12. Panel 1: the declared grid of six periods and two directions, shaded by mean rank IC; the registered point is reversion with period 14 and the search selects momentum with period 28. Panel 2: the registered gate check by check, each observed value against its threshold, all passed, and the live alternate after costs does not object. Panel 3: the same search on the 16 names the provider answered adjusted, without the 12 it only has no corporate action on record for, is refused: its interval spans zero. Panel 4: registration starts scoring on later sessions only; none has been scored yet, and the configuration row still holds the registered parameters until someone edits it.

text.tspan: CLAWOCK · A STRATEGY THAT SEARCHES ITSELF
It may propose its next parameters. It cannot adopt them.
One real run, drawn as it came out: RSI on 2026-10-12.
Mean rank IC over 771 sessions and 28 names.
The grid is declared before the search, so all 12 trials are counted.
An alternate may object. It cannot pass
03 · THE SAME SEARCH WITHOUT THE NAMES ONE PROVIDER VOUCHES FOR
Edge interval. Across zero is no edge:
the candidate rests on those 12 names.
04 · WHAT REGISTRATION STARTS, AND WHERE IT STOPS
scored from here on, 0 so far
Editing it is a reviewed change.
